address: Avenida Sant Llorenç 68, Sant Julià de Vilatorta, 08504, Spain
bio: Located just six kilometres from the town of Vic, this restaurant occupies a farmhouse with a pleasantly rustic ambience plus an attractive glass-fronted terrace. The updated take on traditional cuisine on offer here bears the quality stamp of chef Nandu Jubany, and is showcased via a surprising array of daily dishes (both sweet and savoury) as well as a tasting menu. We can particularly recommend the duck breast glazed with a heather-infused honey, plus the rum baba, the finishing touches to which are added at your table....
